subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt this narrow run/harness/context bucket policy, the broader all-duration policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or hold both until operator-dashboard compatibility proof lands?
rationale: Both PRs use the supported OTel advice mechanism, but they change existing exported metric bucket layouts with different scope and no real export proof, so automation cannot safely choose the product default.

options.title: Resolve Policy And Proof First
options.body: Choose the intended bucket scope, then require the selected branch to include redacted real OTel collector/export evidence before merge.

options.title: Accept This Narrow Policy
options.body: Merge this PR after proof if maintainers want to limit the default change to run, harness, and context-token histograms.

options.title: Adopt The Broader Policy
options.body: Use the overlapping PR as the canonical path if maintainers want all millisecond duration histograms aligned to one bucket policy.

recommendation.title: Resolve Policy And Proof First
recommendation.body: Choose the intended bucket scope, then require the selected branch to include redacted real OTel collector/export evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING lists Vincent Koc for Telemetry and git history shows recent ownership of the diagnostics-otel metric surface.
